description: Curated high-confidence Isabelle/HOL <-> Lean4/Mathlib decl name correspondences for cross-system equivalence bridging. Heuristic candidates, not machine-checked proofs.

aliases.note: Isabelle name is the dotted locale (abel_semigroup) form 'add.commute'; underlying class fact in Groups theory.
Isabelle 'add.assoc' is the dotted semigroup-locale form; Lean groups parenthesization left as (a+b)+c = a+(b+c).
Isabelle 'add_0' : 0 + a = a (monoid_add). Lean 'zero_add' matches; Isabelle 'add_0_right' is the right form.
Isabelle 'add_0_right' : a + 0 = a matches Lean 'add_zero'.
Isabelle group_add left-inverse; common Isabelle form is 'left_minus' (-a + a = 0). Lean modern name is neg_add_cancel (older: add_left_neg). Name uncertainty on both sides.
Isabelle 'right_minus' : a + - a = 0 (group_add). Lean modern name add_neg_cancel (older: add_right_neg).
Isabelle 'minus_minus' : - (- a) = a (group_add).
Isabelle 'diff_conv_add_uminus' : a - b = a + - b. Lean 'sub_eq_add_neg'.
Isabelle 'diff_self' : a - a = 0.
Isabelle 'minus_zero' : - 0 = 0.
Isabelle 'mult.commute' is the dotted commutative-monoid/semigroup locale form.
Isabelle 'mult.assoc' is the dotted semigroup-locale form.
Isabelle 'mult_1' : 1 * a = a (monoid_mult); 'mult_1_left' is also used. Lean 'one_mul'.
Isabelle 'mult_1_right' : a * 1 = a. Lean 'mul_one'.
Isabelle 'mult_zero_left' : 0 * a = 0 (mult_zero class).
Isabelle 'mult_zero_right' : a * 0 = 0.
Isabelle 'distrib_left' : a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c. Lean 'mul_add' (a*(b+c)=a*b+a*c). 'left_distrib' is an alias in Lean.
Isabelle 'distrib_right' : (a + b) * c = a * c + b * c. Lean 'add_mul'. 'right_distrib' is an alias in Lean.
Isabelle 'minus_mult_left' : - (a * b) = - a * b (ring). Lean 'neg_mul' : -a * b = -(a*b). Orientation differs; moderate confidence on exact Isabelle name.
Isabelle 'order_refl' : x <= x (preorder). Lean 'le_refl'; 'le_rfl' is the no-arg form.
Isabelle 'order_trans' : x <= y ==> y <= z ==> x <= z. Also 'order.trans' dotted form exists.
Isabelle 'order_antisym' : x <= y ==> y <= x ==> x = y (order class). Lean 'le_antisymm'.
Isabelle 'less_irrefl' : ~ x < x. Lean 'lt_irrefl'.
Isabelle 'less_trans' : x < y ==> y < z ==> x < z.
Isabelle 'less_imp_le' : x < y ==> x <= y. Lean 'le_of_lt'.
Isabelle 'less_not_sym' : x < y ==> ~ y < x. Lean 'lt_asymm' / 'not_lt_of_gt'. Moderate confidence on exact pairing.

aliases.concept: strict order from le and ne
aliases.note: Isabelle 'le_neq_trans' : a <= b ==> a ~= b ==> a < b. Lean 'lt_of_le_of_ne'. Lower confidence on exact Isabelle name.
Isabelle linorder 'linear' : x <= y | y <= x (also 'linorder_linear'). Lean 'le_total'.
Isabelle 'conj_commute' : (P & Q) = (Q & P). Lean 'and_comm'.
Isabelle 'disj_commute' : (P | Q) = (Q | P). Lean 'or_comm'.
Isabelle 'conj_assoc' : ((P & Q) & R) = (P & (Q & R)). Lean 'and_assoc'.
Isabelle 'disj_assoc'. Lean 'or_assoc'.
Isabelle 'not_not' : (~ ~ P) = P (classical). Lean 'not_not' : Â¬Â¬a â a. Both names coincide; classical in both.
Isabelle 'de_Morgan_conj' : (~ (P & Q)) = (~ P | ~ Q). Lean 'not_and_or' : Â¬(aâ§b) â Â¬a â¨ Â¬b. Classical.
Isabelle 'de_Morgan_disj' : (~ (P | Q)) = (~ P & ~ Q). Lean 'not_or' : Â¬(aâ¨b) â Â¬a â§ Â¬b.
Isabelle 'excluded_middle' : ~ P | P. Lean 'em' (Classical) / 'Decidable.em'. Both classical.
Both express PâQ â Â¬P â¨ Q in classical logic but exact lemma names differ across versions; low confidence, verify before use.
Isabelle has several contrapos_* rules; Lean 'not_imp_not' : (Â¬a â Â¬b) â (b â a). Pairing approximate; verify.
Both define list length; same last segment 'length' but namespaced List in both.
Isabelle uses '@' notation, const 'List.append' (also 'append'). Lean 'List.append' (++). Definitions correspond.
Isabelle 'append_assoc' : (xs @ ys) @ zs = xs @ (ys @ zs). Lean 'List.append_assoc'.
Isabelle 'append_Nil2' : xs @ [] = xs. Lean 'List.append_nil'.
Isabelle 'append_Nil' : [] @ xs = xs (often definitional/simp). Lean 'List.nil_append'.
Isabelle 'length_append' : length (xs @ ys) = length xs + length ys. Lean 'List.length_append'.
Isabelle calls it 'rev'; Lean calls it 'reverse'. Pure last-segment normalization misses this (rev vs reverse).
Isabelle 'rev_rev_ident' : rev (rev xs) = xs. Lean 'List.reverse_reverse'.
Isabelle 'rev_append' : rev (xs @ ys) = rev ys @ rev xs. Lean 'List.reverse_append'. Note Isabelle also has a function named 'rev_append'; the lemma is 'rev_append' too.
Isabelle 'length_rev' : length (rev xs) = length xs. Lean 'List.length_reverse'.
Same name in both; included for completeness as anchor.
Isabelle 'map_append' : map f (xs @ ys) = map f xs @ map f ys. Lean 'List.map_append'.
Isabelle 'length_map' : length (map f xs) = length xs. Lean 'List.length_map'.
Isabelle 'map_map' : map f (map g xs) = map (f o g) xs. Lean 'List.map_map' : map f (map g l) = map (f â g) l.
Isabelle 'rev_map' : rev (map f xs) = map f (rev xs). Lean 'List.map_reverse' : map f l.reverse = (map f l).reverse. Orientation/name correspondence approximate.
Isabelle 'set_append' : set (xs @ ys) = set xs Un set ys (about set, not direct membership). Lean 'List.mem_append' is membership iff. Concepts related but not exact; verify before use.
Isabelle auto-generated 'list.induct'. Lean recursor 'List.rec' (and 'List.recAux'). Principle corresponds but they are mechanism-specific; moderate confidence.

On Nat, Isabelle reuses the generic 'add.commute' (comm_monoid_add); Lean has both type-specific 'Nat.add_comm' and generic 'add_comm'. Pairing is the Nat-specialized Lean lemma to the generic Isabelle one.
Isabelle uses generic 'add.assoc' on nat; Lean 'Nat.add_assoc' (also generic 'add_assoc').
Isabelle generic 'mult.commute' on nat; Lean 'Nat.mul_comm'.
Isabelle datatype-generated 'nat.induct' (also 'nat_induct'). Lean recursor 'Nat.rec'. Mechanism-specific; also compare Lean 'Nat.recAux'.
Isabelle 'add_le_mono' : a <= b ==> c <= d ==> a + c <= b + d. Lean 'add_le_add'.
Isabelle 'le0' : 0 <= n on nat (also 'zero_le'). Lean 'Nat.zero_le'.
Isabelle 'Suc_not_Zero' : Suc m ~= 0. Lean 'Nat.succ_ne_zero'.
Isabelle 'Suc_inject' : Suc m = Suc n ==> m = n (also 'nat.inject'). Lean 'Nat.succ.injEq' / 'Nat.succ_injective'. Moderate confidence on exact Lean name.
Isabelle 'Un_commute' : A Un B = B Un A. Lean 'Set.union_comm'.
Isabelle 'Un_assoc' : (A Un B) Un C = A Un (B Un C). Lean 'Set.union_assoc'.
Isabelle 'Int_commute' : A Int B = B Int A. Lean 'Set.inter_comm'.
Isabelle 'Int_assoc'. Lean 'Set.inter_assoc'.
Isabelle 'subset_refl' : A <= A. Lean 'Set.Subset.refl' (also generic 'le_refl' via order). Name structure differs.
Isabelle 'subset_trans'. Lean 'Set.Subset.trans'. Lean also has 'subset_trans'/'le_trans'.

aliases.concept: union is upper bound (subset of union, left)
aliases.note: Isabelle 'Un_upper1' : A <= A Un B. Lean 'Set.subset_union_left'.

aliases.concept: intersection is lower bound (inter subset, left)
aliases.note: Isabelle 'Int_lower1' : A Int B <= A. Lean 'Set.inter_subset_left'.

aliases.concept: empty set is subset of any set
aliases.note: Isabelle 'empty_subsetI' : {} <= A. Lean 'Set.empty_subset'.
Isabelle 'Un_empty_right' : A Un {} = A. Lean 'Set.union_empty'.
Isabelle 'Int_empty_right' : A Int {} = {}. Lean 'Set.inter_empty'.
Isabelle 'o_assoc' : f o (g o h) = f o g o h. Lean 'Function.comp.assoc' / 'Function.comp_assoc'. Orientation and exact Lean name vary; verify.
Isabelle 'o_id' : f o id = f. Lean 'Function.comp_id'.
Isabelle 'id_o' : id o f = f. Lean 'Function.id_comp'.
Isabelle 'id_apply' : id x = x. Lean 'id_eq' / 'Function.id_def'. Moderate confidence on best Lean pairing.
Isabelle 'inj' (abbrev for inj_on _ UNIV); const 'inj_on'. Lean 'Function.Injective'. Definitions correspond (f x = f y â x = y).
Isabelle 'surj' (range f = UNIV). Lean 'Function.Surjective'.
Isabelle 'bij' = inj & surj. Lean 'Function.Bijective' = Injective â§ Surjective.
Isabelle 'inj_compose' / 'comp_inj_on'. Lean 'Function.Injective.comp'. Exact statement orientation differs; verify.
Isabelle 'power_add' : a ^ (m + n) = a ^ m * a ^ n (monoid_mult). Lean 'pow_add'.
Isabelle 'power_mult' : a ^ (m * n) = (a ^ m) ^ n. Lean 'pow_mul' : a ^ (m * n) = (a ^ m) ^ n.
Isabelle 'power_0' : a ^ 0 = 1. Lean 'pow_zero'.
Isabelle 'power_one' : a ^ 1 = a. Lean 'pow_one'.
Isabelle 'power_mult_distrib' : (a * b) ^ n = a ^ n * b ^ n (comm_monoid_mult). Lean 'mul_pow'.
Isabelle 'one_power' / '1 ^ n = 1' lemma; common name 'power_one_right' is actually a^1; the '1^n' lemma is 'one_power'. Lean 'one_pow'. Verify Isabelle name (likely 'one_power').
Isabelle 'gcd.commute' (dotted, abel_semigroup on gcd) : gcd a b = gcd b a; also 'gcd_commute_nat'. Lean 'Nat.gcd_comm'.
Isabelle 'gcd.assoc' dotted locale form. Lean 'Nat.gcd_assoc'.
Isabelle 'gcd_dvd1' : gcd a b dvd a. Lean 'Nat.gcd_dvd_left'.
Isabelle 'gcd_dvd2' : gcd a b dvd b. Lean 'Nat.gcd_dvd_right'.
Isabelle 'lcm.commute' dotted locale form. Lean 'Nat.lcm_comm'.
Isabelle 'dvd_refl' : a dvd a. Lean 'dvd_refl'. Same name.
Isabelle 'dvd_trans' : a dvd b ==> b dvd c ==> a dvd c. Lean 'dvd_trans' (also 'Dvd.Dvd.trans').
Isabelle 'trans' : a = b ==> b = c ==> a = c (HOL builtin). Lean 'Eq.trans' / 'trans'.
Isabelle 'sym' : s = t ==> t = s. Lean 'Eq.symm'.
Isabelle 'refl' : t = t. Lean 'Eq.refl' / 'rfl'.
Isabelle 'arg_cong' : x = y ==> f x = f y. Lean 'congrArg'.
Isabelle 'sum_list_append' : sum_list (xs @ ys) = sum_list xs + sum_list ys. Lean 'List.sum_append'. Verify exact Isabelle name (sum_list vs listsum across versions).
Isabelle 'abs_mult' : |a * b| = |a| * |b| (linordered ring). Lean 'abs_mul'.
Isabelle 'abs_triangle_ineq' : |a + b| <= |a| + |b|. Lean 'abs_add'.
Isabelle 'abs_ge_zero' : 0 <= |a|. Lean 'abs_nonneg'.
Isabelle 'min.commute' dotted locale form : min a b = min b a. Lean 'min_comm'.
Isabelle 'max.commute' dotted locale form. Lean 'max_comm'.
Isabelle 'min.assoc' dotted locale form. Lean 'min_assoc'.
Isabelle 'max.assoc' dotted locale form. Lean 'max_assoc'.
Isabelle 'if_True' : (if True then x else y) = x. Lean 'if_pos' (for decidable prop) / 'if_true'. Pairing approximate due to decidability framing.
Isabelle 'if_False' : (if False then x else y) = y. Lean 'if_neg' / 'if_false'. Approximate.
Isabelle 'insertI1' : a : insert a B. Lean closest is 'Set.mem_insert' / 'Set.mem_insert_iff'. Concept overlaps but statements differ; low confidence.
Isabelle selector 'hd (x # xs) = x' is auto-generated ('list.sel'). Lean 'List.head_cons' / definitional. Mechanism-specific; low confidence on exact Isabelle fact name.
Isabelle 'filter_append' : filter P (xs @ ys) = filter P xs @ filter P ys. Lean 'List.filter_append'.
Isabelle 'concat (map f xs)' corresponds to Lean's List.flatMap/bind. Definitional correspondence only; verify lemma-level names separately.
Isabelle 'append_take_drop_id' : take n xs @ drop n xs = xs. Lean 'List.take_append_drop'.
Isabelle 'length_take' : length (take n xs) = min n (length xs). Lean 'List.length_take'. RHS form (min) matches in recent Mathlib; verify.
Isabelle 'right_diff_distrib' : a * (b - c) = a * b - a * c (ring). Lean 'mul_sub'. Naming of left/right differs between systems; verify orientation.
Isabelle 'left_diff_distrib' : (a - b) * c = a * c - b * c. Lean 'sub_mul'. Left/right naming convention is mirrored between systems.
Isabelle 'minus_add_distrib' : - (a + b) = - a + - b (ab_group_add). Lean 'neg_add' : -(a + b) = -a + -b.

Isabelle 'add_left_cancel' : (a + b = a + c) = (b = c) cancels the LEFT operand a. Lean 'add_left_cancel' has same meaning; but watch convention. Pairing them as same-meaning; verify which operand each cancels.
Isabelle 'power2_eq_square' : a^2 = a * a. Lean 'sq' is the definition; lemma 'sq' / 'pow_two'. Best Lean lemma is 'pow_two' : a^2 = a*a. Consider mathlib 'pow_two'. Low confidence on exact pairing.
Isabelle 'Suc_le_eq' : (Suc m <= n) = (m < n). Lean 'Nat.succ_le_iff' / 'Nat.lt_iff_add_one_le'. Verify exact Lean name.
Isabelle 'nat_less_induct' / 'less_induct'. Lean 'Nat.strong_induction_on' / 'Nat.strongRecOn'. Names and exact form vary; low confidence.

Isabelle 'add_strict_left_mono' : a < b ==> c + a < c + b. Lean 'add_lt_add_left'.
Isabelle 'mult_le_mono' (nat) : a <= b ==> c <= d ==> a*c <= b*d. Lean 'Nat.mul_le_mul'. General ordered-semiring versions also exist; verify domain.
Weak correspondence; Isabelle membership-in-append is best via 'set_append' rewriting, not a single iff lemma named like Lean's 'List.mem_append'. Low confidence â prefer omitting in strict mode.
Isabelle 'mult_2' : 2 * z = z + z. Lean 'two_mul' : 2 * a = a + a.

Isabelle ring_distribs bundle ('distrib' / 'ring_distribs'). Lean 'left_distrib'/'right_distrib' aliases of mul_add/add_mul. Loose bundle-level correspondence; prefer the specific mul_add/add_mul entries.

Isabelle 'mult_Suc' : m * Suc n = m * n + m. Lean 'Nat.mul_succ' : n * succ m = n * m + n.
Isabelle 'diff_zero' : m - 0 = m (nat, truncated subtraction). Lean 'Nat.sub_zero'.
Isabelle 'diff_self_eq_0' : m - m = 0 (nat). Lean 'Nat.sub_self'.
Isabelle 'if_cancel' : (if c then x else x) = x. Lean 'ite_self' : (if c then a else a) = a.

Isabelle 'P & True = P' lives in the 'simp_thms' bundle (no single canonical named fact in all versions). Lean 'and_true'. Bundle-level; low confidence on exact Isabelle name.
Isabelle 'P | False = P' in 'simp_thms' bundle. Lean 'or_false'. Low confidence on exact Isabelle fact name.
Isabelle 'even_Suc' : even (Suc n) = (~ even n). Lean 'Nat.even_add_one' : Even (n+1) â Â¬Even n.
Isabelle 'gauss_sum' (Gauss_Sum) : 2 * (sum of 1..n) = n*(n+1). Lean 'Finset.sum_range_id_mul_two' / 'Gauss_sum'. Names diverge significantly; low confidence â verify both before relying.
Isabelle 'mono' : x <= y ==> f x <= f y. Lean 'Monotone'. Definitions correspond.
Isabelle 'strict_mono' : x < y ==> f x < f y. Lean 'StrictMono'.
Isabelle 'bot_least' : bot <= a (order_bot). Lean 'bot_le'.
Isabelle 'top_greatest' : a <= top (order_top). Lean 'le_top'.
Isabelle 'sup_ge1' : a <= sup a b (lattice). Lean 'le_sup_left'.
Isabelle 'inf_le1' : inf a b <= a. Lean 'inf_le_left'.
Isabelle 'sup.commute' dotted locale form : sup a b = sup b a. Lean 'sup_comm'.
Isabelle 'inf.commute' dotted locale form. Lean 'inf_comm'.
Weaker pairing; 'append_Nil' is the cleaner Isabelle match for [] @ xs = xs. Included only as alternative; prefer the append_Nil entry. Low confidence.
